{
  "name": "sweet-spot",
  "version": "0.3.1",
  "description": "Hands a long session over, to a fresh one or by compacting, before the context gets too big",
  "author": {
    "name": "Patrick Müller",
    "url": "https://github.com/muellerei"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/muellerei/sweet-spot",
  "repository": "https://github.com/muellerei/sweet-spot",
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code",
    "claude-code-plugin",
    "claude-code-mod",
    "claude-code-mods",
    "claude-mods",
    "function-hooks",
    "context-management",
    "context-window",
    "handoff",
    "compaction",
    "context-compaction",
    "token-optimization",
    "context-rot"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "threshold": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Handoff threshold (tokens)",
      "description": "Context size at which the session is handed over to a fresh one, once the work at hand is done. Values below 130000 are rejected: a fresh session starts at 62k to 98k tokens in real handovers, and a threshold close to that would hand over again soon after.",
      "default": 200000,
      "min": 130000
    },
    "dry_run": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Dry run",
      "description": "Only say that a handoff would happen, and do nothing. Turn it on to watch what the mod would do before it acts.",
      "default": false
    },
    "min_gap_minutes": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Minimum gap after a handoff (minutes)",
      "description": "Least time between one handoff and the next. 0 for no time gap.",
      "default": 10,
      "min": 0
    },
    "min_gap_turns": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Minimum gap after a handoff (turns)",
      "description": "Least number of turns between one handoff and the next. 0 for no turn gap.",
      "default": 5,
      "min": 0
    },
    "later_tokens": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Later, with no number (tokens)",
      "description": "How far /sweet-spot later moves the next handover back when you give it no number: the mod hands over once the context has grown this many tokens past where it was.",
      "default": 25000,
      "min": 1
    },
    "countdown_seconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Countdown before a handover (seconds)",
      "description": "Seconds the mod counts down above the prompt before it hands over on its own. Not now (key 1) moves the handover back as /sweet-spot later does; typing or sending a message stops the countdown, and the next pause counts down again. 0: no countdown, the mod hands over at once. A whole number from 0 to 60.",
      "default": 10,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 60
    },
    "handoff_method": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Handoff method",
      "description": "How the session is handed over. internal-handoff: Claude writes a handoff and the mod starts a fresh session with it. builtin-compact: Claude Code's own /compact, the session stays. external-command: your own command writes the handoff (advanced, see Handoff command).",
      "default": "internal-handoff",
      "options": [
        "internal-handoff",
        "builtin-compact",
        "external-command"
      ]
    },
    "handoff_fallback": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fallback method",
      "description": "Used when the main method fails before it changed the session. internal-handoff, builtin-compact, external-command: as in Handoff method. none: no second try; the mod says why. Same as the main method: no fallback.",
      "default": "builtin-compact",
      "options": [
        "none",
        "internal-handoff",
        "builtin-compact",
        "external-command"
      ]
    },
    "handoff_command": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Handoff command",
      "description": "Only used with external-command (advanced). Name of your own handoff command, as the command list shows it, without the slash.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "idle_handoff": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Handoff after a long pause",
      "description": "Before the prompt cache expires in a long pause, the mod writes a handoff; when you come back after the cache expired, your next message starts a fresh session with it instead of sending the whole conversation again. /resume leads back to the old session. Only with a one-hour cache.",
      "default": true
    },
    "idle_handoff_min_tokens": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Handoff after a long pause, from (tokens)",
      "description": "Context size from which the handoff after a long pause is prepared. 0: sweet-spot works it out from the session's baseline, what a fresh session sends with its first message, plus 30000.",
      "default": 0,
      "min": 0
    }
  }
}
